classification: SOURCE_FACT + INHERITED_CONTRACT + LABELLED_PRIVATE_SERVER_POLICY (C5B_TOP_FLOOR_PRIVATE_POLICY_V1), not recovered original-server behaviour where marked
owner: TopFloor (ladder, player Top Floor state, defense, offered opponents, fight records, day settlements, history facts). Combat, Character, PlayerDisplay, Commerce privilege, I5 Grant/Mail, Achievement and Content keep their ownership.
rules: Top Floor is one ladder per logical server (ranks 1..N, contiguous). Ladder rank mutation, entry and daily settlement serialize on the TopFloor ladder root (lock rank 601) after the actor fence (315) and before Combat (609), I5 Mail (610), Achievement (620) and I5 value (700+).

Times are GMT+8: tickets reset at 05:00; the daily cutoff is 21:00 (misc arena_gift_time1 75600) and no START is admitted from 21:00 to 21:30 (arena_gift_time2 77400). The DB-authoritative decision instant decides every boundary.

A player enters the ladder at the bottom on the first LOAD_ARENA after function 4 (player level 10) is open. 5 free tickets per Top Floor day; a ticket purchase is allowed only at 0 tickets, at most vip.num_arena per day (monthly card does not add purchases), costs refresh_cost.buy_arena_cost[n] crystal and restores arena_buy_num 5. After a fight with 0 < tickets < 5 the next START waits arena_cooldown 300 s; ARENA_RESET_TIMER clears it for arena_refresh_cost 50 crystal when vip.arena_reset == 1 or a monthly card is active.

START_FIGHT (280) runs in one RepeatableRead caller transaction: fence, ladder root, settle-before-mutate, admission (open, not frozen, ticket, cooldown, offered or revengeable opponent within match range, owned formation of 1..5 distinct heroes plus optional owned pet, non-empty defender defense), consume ticket and stamp last_match_time, then Combat StartTx with the challenger as OWNED_SELF and the defender frozen as OWNED_FOREIGN or robot TEMPLATE actors, campaign_type ARENA (Top Floor battle). The locator is one unresolved attempt per challenger; an equivalent repeated START replays the same attempt and never consumes another ticket.

Resolution runs outside locks. A repeated START returns the empty battle_report shape until the resolution exists; once resolved, the first START or worker reconcile settles terminally exactly once: rank swap only when the defender currently ranks better than the challenger and the challenger won (source is_win = star > 0), best-rank update and best-rank reward mail, records for both sides, history facts. Later STARTs return the recorded result without a second settlement.

Daily settlement for each GMT+8 date happens once from the ladder as of 21:00: the first ladder mutation after an unsettled cutoff settles it first (the ladder cannot change in between), and the worker reconcile settles it promptly otherwise. Each ranked player in an arena_reward range receives one mail (arena_mail_title/text/sender, daily_diamond crystal, daily_mana mana, daily_arena_coin arena_coin, daily_item×daily_item_num, and frame_id 120001004 on rank 1). The immutable day snapshot records ranks for the Achievement 100001 streak.

Best rank reward: whenever a terminal settlement improves a player's historical best rank, crystal = Arena.getRankReward(old best, new best) over rank_reward_diamond_new (function 84 open_control 1), at least 1, delivered by mail; the START response award_crystal echoes it.

Achievement 100001 Challenger: a player's consecutive day snapshots with rank <= 3 form a streak that resets on a day outside the top 3 or unranked; tiers 1/2/3 are earned at 3/6/10 days and never revoked. The Achievement owner records them through a typed producer in the settlement transaction (scoped I7C-4B amendment).

Private policy C5B_TOP_FLOOR_PRIVATE_POLICY_V1 (labelled, versioned): robot ladder from robot.lua with rank r holding team 10326 - r; robot TEMPLATE heroes from robot_hero (table_id=partner_id, lev, star, color=quality, equips); robot display name from random_name type-0 + type-1 parts by robot id, avatar 110001001, frame 120001001, level team_level; three opponents from better-rank bands set by arena_match_param 0.98/0.5/0.3, deterministic per player/day/refresh; revenge range [ceil(0.3r), r-1]; defense defaults empty and empty defenses are not offered; seal-hero feature closed; records keep the last 10 per player; lifetime history facts from producer start, counted for both sides, per-partner usage from the persisted report.

Wire shapes follow src_64 Arena.lua, ArenaWindow, ArenaSelectTeamNewWindow, ArenaRecordWindow, ArenaRecordPlayerInfoWindow and RankList (sub_type 1). Full player id = table_id + region*100000; robots use table_id <= 25000. Per-fight items are empty and partner_favor is {} (no base per-fight reward in source).

Content: a pinned top_floor catalog compiled from arena_reward, misc, vip, refresh_cost, robot, robot_hero and random_name; arena_coin becomes ENABLED_R4 because Top Floor is its income owner. ARENA_MODE (282-300), 274/275/277/276/279 and the 1829 history projection are not activated.
